subject: 锦州广济寺塔 · 八角十三层密檐塔正面全貌
name: 锦州广济寺塔
yearNote: 辽清宁三年（1057）立塔（辽宁文旅）；塔刹早毁，1996年维修时参照同期辽塔复原，通高71.25米为维修后数据。年份取建塔年，塔刹为现代复原件。
coordinate_source: OpenStreetMap（Nominatim 检索“广济寺塔 锦州”）节点“广济寺塔，北街，古城街道，古塔区”41.1092294, 121.1197088，塔体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 ln_jinzhou（锦州市代表点，Wikidata Q28996：41.11444, 121.12917）。
lede: 辽清宁三年（1057）为供奉皇太后所赐舍利而建，立在大广济寺之前，是辽西最高的古建筑。八角实心的砖身坐在须弥座上，每面一龛坐佛、两侧胁侍，其上十三重密檐层层收分，1996年复原的塔刹把通高推到七十一米余。
facts: 年代：辽道宗清宁三年（1057）立；明清屡修，塔刹早毁，1996年维修时参照同期辽塔复原。2001年随“广济寺古建筑群”列第五批国保。
形制：八角十三层实心密檐式砖塔，通高71.25米；塔由基座、塔身、塔檐、塔顶组成，塔身每面正中拱形佛龛内雕坐佛一尊，龛侧立胁侍，上出砖雕斗栱承第一层檐。
图版：以2023年正面实拍为主，十三重檐按2010年侧前方实拍逐层核对；塔前大广济寺殿宇、围栏与游人去除，只画塔与须弥座。
caption: 锦州广济寺塔 · 八角十三层密檐
辽 · 1057
structure_checkpoints: 基座：须弥座式基座，上部有一圈仿木斗栱与栏板带（2010年照片可见），下部素面；2023年正面照片基座下部被寺前殿宇遮挡，按2010年照片补全。
塔身：八角形，正面一面为拱形佛龛内坐佛，龛两侧各一立姿胁侍，龛上方有宝盖与飞天浮雕；相邻两面亦各有龛像，正面可见三个面。
第一层檐：塔身顶部出一圈砖雕斗栱（每面多攒），承托最宽的第一层檐。
密檐：第一层檐以上再叠十二层逐层收窄的叠涩檐，合计十三重檐。2010年侧前方实拍（檐角对天）逐檐计数为13；2023年正面照片因对比度低，目视与灰度剖面计数在12—13之间，以侧前方实拍与文献“十三层”为准。各檐角悬风铎，檐面覆灰筒瓦。
塔刹：1996年复原件——须弥座式刹座上置仰莲、覆钵，上接刹杆串五颗宝珠，杆顶有圆形火焰/圆光饰；八角各有一条拉索（线稿不画拉索）。
material_observations: 塔身青灰色砖砌，砖缝细密；檐口灰筒瓦、檐角风铎深灰；佛龛内造像与胁侍为灰色砖雕，局部泛黄白；塔刹为灰色砖石与深色金属刹杆；基座灰石。
author: EditQ（호고호）

source_note: 主图为 EditQ 2023 年 5 月正面实拍（CC BY-SA 4.0），塔身龛像、斗栱与塔刹清楚，基座下部被大广济寺殿宇遮挡；补充图为 Rrmarcellus 2010 年侧前方实拍（CC BY-SA 3.0），用于逐檐计数与基座。两图均经 Read 查看并裁图计数。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Guangji Temple Pagoda (广济寺塔) in Jinzhou, Liaoning, a Liao-dynasty (1057) octagonal solid brick pagoda with dense eaves, drawn straight on from Image 2 (2023 frontal photo); Image 3 (2010 oblique photo) is only for counting the eaves and seeing the lower pedestal. From bottom to top: a Sumeru pedestal with a band of brick bracket-sets and balustrade panels; a tall octagonal first storey showing three faces, the front face with an arched niche containing a seated Buddha flanked by two standing attendants and a canopy with flying apsaras above; a ring of brick bracket-sets carrying the broad first eave; then EXACTLY TWELVE more corbelled eaves above it, each slightly narrower (THIRTEEN eaves in total including the broad first eave), with small bells at the corners; a flat top with a restored finial: lotus base, inverted bowl, a thin mast with five beads and a small round flame-disc ornament. Remove the temple hall with red doors in front of the pedestal, the railings, people, lamp posts, paving and the guy-wires. Portrait 1024×1536, whole pagoda from pedestal to finial about 82% of height, centred.
Orientation: portrait 1024×1536.
